kjv: I go not up yet unto this feast
mine: I am not going up to this feast
note: TR "oupo" (not yet) against "ouk" (not) in Sinaiticus, D; scribes softened the apparent contradiction with 7:10. SBLGNT reads "ouk".

kjv: for the Holy Ghost was not yet [given]
mine: for as yet the Spirit had not been given
note: TR adds "hagion"; both supply "given" (KJV in italics).

kjv: And every man went unto his own house.
mine: [[And each went to his own house.
note: 7:53–8:11 (the woman taken in adultery) is absent from P66, P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, A and C (lacunose), W and the early versions; no Greek Father comments on it before the 12th century; some manuscripts place it after Lk 21:38 or Jn 21:25. SBLGNT double-brackets it. The KJV prints it as John's text. Context: a later addition (high confidence). 7:52 flows directly into 8:12 'Again Jesus spoke to them'; the passage's vocabulary is Lukan rather than Johannine.
